summary: The recorded base reproduced the delayed final-prefill abort commit race. The exact candidate prevents pending-finish prefill admission to optimistic decode, consumes the delayed result with zero accepted tokens, suppresses token-derived metadata, preserves packed cursors for later requests, and reuses normal finished-request cleanup. Independent adversarial checks also preserved mixed-batch decode partial-output semantics.

tests.what_was_measured: On base 358c163, 3 failed and 11 passed with 2 subtests: optimistic-decode admission occurred, output_ids changed from [] to [101], and sampling-mask overflow overrode the pending abort.
Exact candidate regression suite: 20 passed and 2 subtests passed, including admission, token/metadata suppression, sampling-mask precedence, cursor alignment, and grammar behavior.
Independent selection of existing adjacent boundaries: 8 passed.
Two review-only adversarial tests passed: normal cleanup was invoked without unfinished caching, and mixed-batch decode retained its committed token before abort.
The exact candidate's changed Python source compiled successfully.
Whole-candidate whitespace check found trailing whitespace only in committed raw pytest logs; restricting the check to python/ and test/ returned zero.

gpu_execution_evidence: The reviewer confirmed ROCm 7.2 sees one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950). Candidate-retained logs show a prior tiny-Llama gfx950 server smoke, but the review did not rerun a GPU server and does not treat that unrelated smoke as race proof.
remaining_limitations: No exact-race HTTP/GPU reproduction was run; deterministic scheduler and result-processor tests provide the issue-specific evidence.
No Qwen weights or semantic model validation was performed.
No multi-GPU, pipeline-parallel, data-parallel, distributed, or multi-node runtime validation was performed.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The complete candidate diff has trailing whitespace in retained raw pytest logs, although source and test files pass git diff --check.
